location: src/pages/settings/administration/ProjectDetailsPage.tsx:254-255 and src/pages/settings/administration/projectsManagement/ProjectBudgetsSection.tsx:209-210 — the new project={project} and canManageBudgets={canManageBudgets} props are threaded ProjectDetailsPage -> ProjectBudgetsSection -> UnifiedProjectBudgetModal to seed and save chargeback
trigger_condition: If either pass-through hop drops or mis-wires the project or canManageBudgets prop, the modal receives project=null / canManageBudgets=false and no test observes the loss.
guard_snippet: A test rendering ProjectDetailsPage (or ProjectBudgetsSection) with a project carrying chargeback_enabled/chargeback_attribution/cost_center_id, asserting the rendered UnifiedProjectBudgetModal seeds those values and that Update Budget calls projectsStore.updateProject with them — instead of the modal being constructed directly with props already supplied.
potential_consequence: With project not forwarded, the modal seeds chargeback_enabled=false and links no cost center, so saving silently overwrites the project's existing chargeback settings to disabled; with canManageBudgets not forwarded (defaults false), the `if (isChargebackFeatureEnabled && canManageBudgets)` block is skipped and chargeback edits never persist. UnifiedProjectBudgetModal.chargeback.test.tsx passes project/canManageBudgets straight into the modal (renderPopulated -> Wrapper), so it exercises the modal but never the wiring; ProjectDetailsPage.test.tsx renders the page but asserts nothing about the budget section props (and its mockProject omits chargeback fields), and ProjectBudgetsSection has no test file at all.
consumer: UnifiedProjectBudgetModal opened from the project budgets section on the admin ProjectDetailsPage (src/pages/settings/administration/projectsManagement/ProjectBudgetsSection.tsx:206-211)
evidence: Read UnifiedProjectBudgetModal.chargeback.test.tsx (constructs the modal via Wrapper with project/canManageBudgets passed directly, lines ~864-1009); read ProjectDetailsPage.test.tsx (no assertion on ProjectBudgetsSection/UnifiedProjectBudgetModal props, mockProject has no chargeback fields); Grep for ProjectBudgetsSection across the repo returned only the source file and ProjectDetailsPage.tsx (no test importing or rendering it).
